caption: The drawing depicts a simple rectangular building with a gabled roof, topped by a cross. The building is shown in a frontal view and appears to be constructed of alternating rows of light and dark bricks, with the upper portion of the roof shaded solidly. There are two rectangular openings: a large doorway at the center bottom and a smaller, window-like opening directly above it, both outlined with a solid dark border. A rectangular plaque is visible on the right side of the building's facade. Beneath the structure, there is a ribbon-like banner with the text "1823 Misión San Francisco de Solano" written on it. The image uses only shades of gray, indicating it is rendered in pencil or ink on a light, plain background.
title: Mision San Francisco de Solano
